violations.text: The floors in the meat and dairy/produce walk-in coolers have exposed cement which is not durable, easily cleanable, or non-absorbent. The materials for indoor floors must be durable, easily cleanable and nonabsorbent for areas subject to moisture such as food preparation areas, walk-in refrigerators, ware-washing areas, and toilet rooms. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 10/23/2026
The ware-washing area is lacking a hand-washing sink. New Violation. Correct By: 09/23/2026

Molluscan Shellfish tags did not have all of the required information. The following was observed: 1) Last date of sale were lacking. 2) Tags not maintained in chronological order Molluscan shellfish tags must be maintained for 90 days in chronological order and the date when the last shellfish was used from the bag must be noted on the shellfish tag. New Violation. Correct By: 09/23/2026

Foods in the front retail (durker coolers) was observed held at 42-44 degrees Fahrenheit. Coolers observed set to 38-39 degrees Fahrenheit for ambient temperature. Ambient temperature of coolers observed at 39-45 degrees Fahrenheit. Defrost cycles adjusted by person in charge. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/23/2026

Various food items (candy, baked goods, frozen meats, prepared foods) packaged in the food establishment are lacking labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, the business name/address, and major allergens. New Violation. Correct By: 09/23/2026
The spikes of the slicer grip was observed to be worn down. Equipment must remain in good repair and proper adjustment. New Violation. Correct By: 10/07/2026

The following was observed of non-food contact surfaces: 1) The fan covers in all the walk-in coolers were observed with dust 2) The retail dairy cooler was observed with old milk residue on the shelving 3) The door tracks/handles/shelving in the meat and deli coolers were observed with food debris The non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned as often as necessary to prevent the possible contamination of food. New Violation. Correct By: 09/23/2026
